metadata.title: Opti Assist
metadata.description: AI assistant for factory floors — fast, grounded answers from your machines, manuals, and data.

errors.loginFailed: Login failed ({status}). Try again in a moment.
errors.noToken: Login failed — no session was received. Try again.
errors.generic: Login failed. Check your connection and try again.

forgotPassword.heading: Reset your password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your account email. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a reset link.
forgotPassword.sentHint: Check your inbox — and your spam folder, just in case. The link is valid for a limited time.

resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.doneBody: Your password has been updated. You can now log in with the new password.
resetPassword.linkInvalidHint: The link may have expired or already been used.
resetPassword.policy: Password must be at least {min} characters and include an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number, and a special character.

consent.heading: Before you continue
consent.subtitle: Opti Assist is provided to your employer under a master agreement with Optipeople. Please confirm you've read the two short documents below.
consent.termsLabel: I have read and accept the end-user terms of use.
consent.privacyLabel: I have read the privacy notice and understand how my data is processed.
consent.analyticsLabel: I agree to anonymous product analytics (optional).
consent.analyticsDescription: Helps Optipeople improve the product. You can change this at any time. Has no effect on what's logged for audit purposes.
consent.requiredHint: * Required. Optipeople records your acceptance against your email for audit purposes.

qrBanner.title: By using Opti Assist on this machine
qrBanner.body: You agree to the <terms>end-user terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>. Your factory has already signed the master agreement with Optipeople.

consent.loadFailed: Could not check your consent status.

accountSelect.heading: Choose account
accountSelect.subtitle: You have access to several accounts. Choose the one you want to work in.
accountSelect.empty: No machines have been added to Opti Assist yet. Email {email} for help getting started.
accountSelect.loadFailed: Could not load your accounts. Check your connection and try again.

newAccountWizard.step1Description: The account is created in Optipeople together with its first administrator, who receives an invitation email.
newAccountWizard.accountCreatedButUnresolved: The account was created in Optipeople, but its id could not be resolved, so the remaining steps can't run here. Finish the setup in the Optipeople portal.
newAccountWizard.step2Description: Machines always belong to a factory. You can skip this and add it in the Optipeople portal later.
newAccountWizard.timeZoneEmpty: No time zones found for this country
newAccountWizard.step3Description: Adds the machine to Opti Assist so its knowledge base and chat work right away. It can be linked to an Optipeople machine later.
newAccountWizard.step4Description: Optionally add another user to the account. The administrator from step 1 has already been invited.
newAccountWizard.doneDescription: {account} is ready. You can now select it from the account list.
newAccountWizard.emailInvalid: Enter a valid e-mail address (e.g. name@company.com)
newAccountWizard.closeConfirmBody: The account "{account}" has already been created in Optipeople. The remaining steps can be finished later in the Optipeople portal — don't create the account again.

feedback.promptHint: Help the next operator by telling us whether the answer solved your problem.
feedback.thanksResolved: Marked as resolved. This helps the next operator with the same issue.
feedback.thanksUnresolved: Marked as unresolved. We'll look into it.
feedback.solutionLabel: What worked? (optional — will be shared with the next operator)
feedback.solutionPlaceholder: E.g. The RESET button + restart the controller after reading the alarm code.
feedback.noCommentPlaceholder: E.g. the answer didn't match my machine or the problem.

aiRules.heading: AI rules — {name}
aiRules.description: The locked rule below is always enforced. Add additional rules to encode account-specific guidance (e.g. safety reminders).
aiRules.deleteConfirmBody: The rule will be removed from every chat in this account. This cannot be undone.
aiRules.lockedFootnote: This rule is the same for every account and cannot be edited. It keeps the assistant on topic and resists attempts to talk it out of its role.
aiRules.addDescription: Plain-language instruction the assistant must follow. Keep it short and specific.
aiRules.addPlaceholder: e.g. Always remind operators to lock out the spindle before performing a tool change.

mcp.heading: MCP integration
mcp.descriptionScoped: OAuth credentials this account uses to call the Optipeople MCP server. The chat uses these to fetch machine data on the account's behalf.
mcp.descriptionAll: Per-account credentials for the Optipeople MCP server. The chat uses these to fetch machine data on behalf of each account.
mcp.redirectUriLabel: OAuth redirect URI (used during dynamic client registration)
mcp.redirectUriHint: Each registration creates a new entry in the Optipeople portal's Client Secrets list — no manual registration needed.
mcp.emptyScoped: This account isn't connected to the MCP server yet. Click Connect to register an OAuth client and run consent.
mcp.emptyAll: No accounts have MCP credentials yet. Click Add credentials to wire one up.
mcp.disconnectConfirmBody: The OAuth credentials are deleted, and the chat immediately loses access to live machine data for this account until an admin reconnects and runs consent again.
mcp.addDescription: Provision a fresh OAuth client at the MCP server for this account. The server issues a Client ID + Secret automatically — same flow ChatGPT uses. After registration, click Connect on the row to run the OAuth consent step.
mcp.labelPlaceholder: Shows up in the portal's Client Secrets list

accountUsage.description: AI token usage across chat, document ingestion and search for the last {days} days.
accountUsage.cacheHelp: Prompt-cache traffic on chat calls: tokens read from the cache (billed at a fraction of input price) and tokens written to it.

accountUsage.costHelp: Estimated USD at current list prices, derived from the recorded tokens. Voice (speech) calls are not metered yet, so they are not included.
accountUsage.costHelpIncomplete: Estimated USD at current list prices. {models} model(s) have no price on file and are excluded, so the real figure is higher. Voice (speech) calls are not metered yet either.
